page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. It features 16 vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its bundled local storage, consisting of 47244 GB of HDD capacity. This massive storage volume is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this configuration.

The hardware profile presents specific tradeoffs. While the 47 TB HDD storage capacity offers high density for cold data storage and large-scale sequential data processing, the mechanical nature of HDD storage limits random IOPS compared to modern solid-state drives. Additionally, the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor represents an older CPU generation, which may impact compute-intensive workloads but provides a cost-efficient option for storage-heavy applications that do not require high-frequency compute resources.

This server configuration is designed for workloads requiring substantial local storage capacity with moderate compute requirements. Suitable use cases include distributed file systems, big data analytics platforms, data warehousing, cold storage archives, and large-scale log processing.
